## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (81%)** · Ambiguous: Invasive vs Normal · Careful review
Priority tier 1 surgical frozen section with Normal in the prediction set and positive margin calls.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 81%, Normal 16%, InSitu 2%, Benign 0% [F1] | Favors Invasive; Normal remains plausible |
| Conformal set | Normal, Invasive (90% target; 90% test coverage) | Cannot separate Invasive from Normal |
| Reliability / OOD | 96% reliability, 76th percentile OOD, 12/12 tiles kept [F6] | Typical image; input not flagged |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent foundation models agree |
| Similar cases | 1/5 Invasive, 4/5 Normal (80–82% similarity) [F5] | Nearest neighbors mostly labeled Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 1, 4) · ↑ invasive · Strongest invasive push (+1.18); 19/20 AI spot-check [F2] · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 2, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Pushes toward Normal (-0.81), but 0/20 AI spot-check [F3] · Unreliable
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 1, 4, 5) · ↑ invasive · Pushes toward Invasive (+0.81), but weak and 0/20 spot-check [F4] · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 4, 8) · context · Descriptive stromal inflammation score (-0.59); 8/20 AI spot-check · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 3, 7, 11) · ↓ invasive · Supports non-invasive right half (-0.44); 20/20 AI spot-check · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; deleting top 3 risk regions drops invasive score above random (+0.0114, CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven classifier faithfulness (CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); uses unreliable mitoses (0/20), normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Left-half high-risk tiles reflect frozen-section or composite artifact rather than true invasion; 4/5 similar cases are Normal.
- Separation from top Normal neighbor BACH_0062 (82% similarity) depends on unreliable necrosis (3/20) and mitoses (0/20) concepts.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 1, 4, 5, 8, 9**: Verify stromal invasion and pleomorphism versus frozen artifact on left.
2. **Regions 0, 1, 4, 8, 9**: Check positive superior, inferior (430 um), and medial (645 um) margins [F7].
3. **Regions 2, 3, 6, 7, 10, 11**: Confirm benign fibrous stroma and fat in low-risk right tiles.
